audiences.name: Fractional CFOs & Advisors
audiences.target: Accounting firms, strategic advisors, and outsourced CFO desks
audiences.friction: Wasting billable hours reviewing raw bank statements and deciphering lender guidelines.
audiences.solution: Standardized financial intake and pre-packaged debt advisory packets.

audiences.name: Commercial Loan Brokers
audiences.target: Independent debt originators and multi-broker syndication teams
audiences.friction: Slow deal velocity caused by disorganized email threads and lender shotgunning.
audiences.solution: Algorithmic lender matching and automated borrower document collection.

audiences.name: Fintechs & SaaS Platforms
audiences.target: B2B marketplaces, vertical software, and ERP providers
audiences.friction: High engineering cost and compliance risk of building in-house capital origination.
audiences.solution: Turnkey commercial lending endpoints and embedded debt routing.

audiences.name: Lender Networks & Syndicates
audiences.target: Non-bank private credit funds, SBA originators, and asset-backed lenders
audiences.friction: Screening hundreds of non-conforming, incomplete loan submissions.
audiences.solution: Receive verified borrower packets structured directly to your credit box.
